subject: general
question: Average age of group A of 10 students is 20 years. Average age of group B of 20 students is 'x' years. Combined average age of group A and group B is 34 years. What is the value of 'x'?
solution:
**Given:**

Group A students = 10

Average of A = 20

Group B students = 20

Average of B = x

Combined average = 34

**Formula Used:**

Total sum = Number × Average

Combined average = (Sum of all values) &
